findings.description: The KMS key does not have automatic key rotation enabled (enable_key_rotation is not set to true), which increases the risk of long-term key compromise since the same cryptographic material continues to be used indefinitely.

No key policy is defined for the KMS key, which means it will use the default policy granting full access to the account root, potentially allowing any IAM principal with broad permissions to use or manage the key without more granular restriction.
